sloka: प्रियङ्गुभिः कदम्बैश्च तथा च वकुलैरपि ।जम्बूभिर्दाडिमैश्चैव कोविदारैश्च शोभिताम् ।। ७.४२.५ ॥
transliteration: priyaṅgubhiḥ kadambaiśca tathā ca vakulairapi ।jambūbhirdāḍimaiścaiva kovidāraiśca śobhitām ।। 7.42.5 ॥

translations.english: It was further adorned by Priyangu, Kadamba, Bakula, Jambu, Pomegranate, and Kovidara trees.
